jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview::
**Project Coordinator**
Location: **San Francisco, CA**  

HGA is seeking a dynamic and driven **Project Coordinator** to join our San Francisco, CA Interior Design team. We’re looking for someone with exceptional communication, presentation, time‑management, and interpersonal skills—someone who thrives in a collaborative setting and is passionate about elevating design.  

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Interior Designers, Project Architects, and Project Managers to help shape innovative, technically sound design solutions. You’ll contribute to the development of detailed project documentation while upholding our firm’s commitment to design excellence and outstanding client service.### **What You’ll Do:**

* Partner on the development of construction documents and ensure design intent is accurately carried through.
* Translate complex project goals into creative and functional design solutions.
* Collaborate across disciplines to coordinate architectural and engineering systems.
* Participate in client meetings and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Partner to meet critical project milestones and deadlines maintaining a high level of attention to detail and quality.

 **In this role you will:**  

* Develop a thorough understanding of projects’ design philosophy and provide major input in developing a design and building performance strategy, effectively conveying this to assigned team members when appropriate.
* Provide technical design input and support for the development of the entire design concept.
* Coordinate the project’s technical design effort, subsequent detailed design development, project coordination and quality control efforts during all phases of project work, in close collaboration with an Interior Designer, Project Architect, Senior Designer and Project Manager.
* Seek creative and innovative solutions to assigned tasks and develop appropriate research and documents to support these solutions.
* Actively collaborate with and coordinate work of consultants and knowledge resources to ensure the project deliverables are coordinated, integrated and support the design concept and performance goals of the project.
* Contribute to the preparation of design documents and leads the detailed development of construction documents during all project phases, delivering complete, accurate and coordinated project documentation.
* Advance the production of schematic, design development and construction document drawings and specifications in compliance with project scope, schedule, cost and design intent.
* Review and coordinate project documents with relevant Building Codes, City Planning/Zoning ordinances and similar requirements for Authorities Having Jurisdiction.
* Maintain awareness of evolving building technology and systems.
* Review shop drawings, material samples and Construction Documents for conformance with design.
* Perform construction administration duties (e.g., RFI’s, RFP’s, change orders, etc.).
* Maintain contact with clients, consultants and contractors during all project phases, participating in marketing, client and owner presentations as required.

 **What you will need to have:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited Interior Design/Interior Architecture program or related field
* 5 to 7 years of experience working on small\- to large\-scale project types
* Experience with TI and core and shell
* Strong graphic skills
* Revit knowledge and experience required
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp and other industry accepted software as well as expertise with project management software and Microsoft Office Suite products is needed
* Ability to travel to job sites

 **Salary Information:**  

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short\- and long\-term disability programs. Salary Range: $85,000 \- $96,000 **depending on qualifications and experience**. **Additional Information:**  

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work\-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award\-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.  

Learn more about us **here****.** **Application Requirements \& Instructions**  

Please submit resume and portfolio for consideration.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help turn Casco's founder\-led sales momentum into a repeatable outbound engine. You'll start conversations with AppSec leaders and CISOs who know annual pentests and noisy security scanners cannot keep up with how quickly modern teams ship software. Your job is to make the problem urgent, earn the right to a deeper conversation, and create qualified pipeline for Casco's autonomous security testing platform.


This is not a role where you inherit a perfect script and spend all day blasting sequences. You'll work in person with our founders and sales team in San Francisco, learn how technical security buyers think, test messages in the market, and help build the outbound playbook as Casco scales after its Series A.

**What You'll Actually Do**
---------------------------

* **Create qualified pipeline:** Research target accounts, identify the right AppSec and security leaders, and turn cold accounts into real sales conversations.
* **Write outbound that sounds human:** Build sharp, account\-specific messaging across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other channels instead of hiding behind generic sequences.
* **Learn the security problem:** Understand how companies buy pentests today, where point\-in\-time testing falls short, and why continuous autonomous testing matters.
* **Qualify for substance:** Find a credible security problem, relevant use case, buying context, and concrete next step before handing an opportunity to an Account Executive.
* **Work events:** Attend security events with the team, start conversations in the room, and follow up fast enough to turn interest into pipeline.
* **Build the playbook:** Test personas, industries, hooks, objections, and channels, then document what works so we can repeat it.
* **Keep the CRM honest:** Record the source, account, persona, meeting outcome, and next step so the team can trust the pipeline and improve the motion.
* **Close the feedback loop:** Share what prospects say with founders, sales, engineering, and security so we keep sharpening the product and the story.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must\-Haves**

* At least one year of outbound SDR or BDR experience in B2B software, with evidence that you can consistently create qualified meetings.
* Strong writing and research skills. You can find a real reason to contact an account and explain it without corporate filler.
* Comfort on the phone. You can open a cold conversation, ask a useful question, listen, and earn a next step.
* The curiosity to learn application security, pentesting, vulnerabilities, cloud environments, APIs, and how technical buyers evaluate new security products.
* Good judgment about quality. You would rather create the right meeting than hit a vanity activity number.
* Resilience and follow\-through. You can handle rejection, keep your standards high, and stay organized across a large account set.
* Startup readiness. You are comfortable testing ideas, working without a finished playbook, and making your own progress visible.
* The ability to work in person from our San Francisco office.

### **Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience prospecting into cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, or another technical category.
* Familiarity with AppSec leaders, security engineers, CISOs, or the pentesting market.
* Experience at an early\-stage startup or helping create a new outbound motion.
* A genuine interest in how attackers think and how AI is changing offensive security.

**Your First Three Months**
---------------------------


You'll have a three\-month ramp to learn Casco, our buyers, and the outbound motion before carrying a full quota.

* **Month 1 — 25% quota:** Learn the product and market, build account lists, practice the story, and begin live prospecting.
* **Month 2 — 50% quota:** Run consistent outbound, handle common objections, and create your first accepted opportunities.
* **Month 3 — 75% quota:** Own a defined account set and build a repeatable weekly pipeline rhythm.
* **Month 4 onward — 100% quota:** Carry the full monthly target.


During the three\-month ramp, you'll receive guaranteed variable compensation while you build toward full productivity.

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------

* This is not a remote role. You will build the motion alongside the team in our San Francisco office.
* This is not an activity contest where a dashboard full of calls matters more than whether anyone should take the meeting.
* This is not a mature sales organization with a finished script, perfect data, and every objection already documented.
* This is not a role for someone who wants to sell a checkbox. You will need to explain why a new approach to security testing should exist.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **San Francisco based:** Work in person with our founders, sales team, engineers, and security experts.
* **Compensation:**


	+ Base salary: $80,000
	+ Target variable: $40,000
	+ On\-target earnings: $120,000
	+ Equity grant with meaningful ownership in Casco
* **Real ownership:** Help build the outbound motion for a new category instead of inheriting someone else's playbook.
* **Direct access:** Learn alongside founders and technical teammates who can answer hard questions and act quickly on market feedback.
* **A product with proof:** Casco has already found critical vulnerabilities across 300\+ companies despite their existing security tools and human pentesters.
* **Learning opportunities:** We support your growth with a budget for conferences, books, courses, and the tools that help you improve.

**Our Mission**
---------------


Casco's mission is to make all software effortlessly secure. We build AI agents that think like attackers and give security teams solutions instead of another pile of noisy alerts.


The time it takes attackers to weaponize vulnerabilities is collapsing, while companies are shipping more software than eve

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sell something local business owners actually want: a phone that rings.

Look Good Online builds websites and runs local marketing, Google visibility, reviews, call tracking, for small service businesses across Georgia and Texas: plumbers, roofers, HVAC companies, dentists, contractors. Most of them already know their website is dead or they can't be found on Google. You're not creating a problem to sell against, you're offering the fix to one they already have. You reach out, show them what we do, and close them onto a monthly plan. Our production team builds and manages everything after that — you never touch a website.

How you get paid

Every client pays you in real dollars, not vague percentages:

The Sketch ($350/mo plan): $105 up front, then $52\.50 every month the client stays.

The Masterpiece ($850/mo plan): $255 up front, then $127\.50 every month the client stays.

The Gallery ($1,900/mo plan): $570 up front, then $285 every month the client stays.

Simple Sites ($100–$200/mo plans): $15–$30 up front, then $10–$20 every month the client stays.

That second number is the one that matters. It lands every month the client stays, whether you sell anything new that month or not. Ten Masterpiece clients on your book is $1,275 a month showing up on its own. Thirty is $3,825\.

Closing a steady 2–3 accounts a month, your recurring income alone is on track to run over $4,000/month by month twelve, and it keeps compounding from there because nothing you sold stops paying just because the month ended.

Stay five years, keep it forever. At the five\-year mark your recurring commission vests permanently. You keep collecting on every client you ever brought in, for as long as they keep paying, even if you've moved on to something else entirely.

No hours, no schedule, nobody tracking your time. This isn't a call\-center job. No minimum hours, no shift, no time\-tracking software. We don't care when or where you work. We care whether you close deals.

What you'll do: find local businesses in GA/TX that need help, reach out however closes deals for you, walk owners through our plans, and keep a simple log of who you talked to (that's your proof of the sale — it protects your commission).

What we give you: a full call script and objection\-handling playbook, real live client sites to point to, a checkout link and e\-signature so closing takes minutes, and a production team so you're never on the hook for anything technical.

Who we're looking for: comfortable calling a business owner cold, can hear "no" ten times and make the eleventh call, organized enough to keep a log current, 18\+ and authorized to work in the US as an independent contractor. Sales experience helps, it's not required.

Pay: $34,000\.00 \- $127,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Referral program

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
Influencer Marketing Specialist

**Job Type:** Full\-time / Part\-time / Contract (Based on Experience)

**Location:** Hybrid / Remote

About Us

We are a wellness and lifestyle brand dedicated to inspiring healthier, more intentional living through community events, travel experiences, and personal development. Our mission is to create meaningful connections both online and in person, and we're looking for a creative, results\-driven Influencer Marketing Specialist to help grow our digital presence.

Position Summary

As an Influencer Marketing Specialist, you will develop and execute influencer campaigns that increase brand awareness, engagement, and community growth. You'll build relationships with content creators, manage social media collaborations, analyze campaign performance, and help tell authentic stories that resonate with diverse audiences.

Responsibilities

* Develop and execute influencer marketing campaigns aligned with brand objectives.
* Research, identify, recruit, and manage influencers across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other platforms.
* Build long\-term partnerships with creators and brand ambassadors.
* Coordinate campaign timelines, contracts, content approvals, and deliverables.
* Monitor campaign performance using analytics and reporting tools.
* Track engagement, reach, conversions, and ROI to optimize future campaigns.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling social media content.
* Assist with photography, video production, and creative content development.
* Schedule and publish content using social media management platforms.
* Support event promotion, product launches, and community\-building initiatives.
* Stay informed on influencer marketing trends, platform updates, and emerging creators.

Qualifications

* Experience in influencer marketing, social media management, or digital marketing.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging social platforms.
* Experience using Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, or similar marketing tools.
* Knowledge of social media analytics and performance reporting.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) or Canva; video editing experience is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Experience with SEO, content marketing, and brand storytelling is preferred.
* Photography and content creation experience is a plus.

Preferred Skills

* Influencer outreach and relationship management
* Social listening and trend analysis
* Content strategy and campaign planning
* Copywriting and editing
* Branding and community engagement
* Data analysis and reporting
* Time management and multitasking

Benefits

* Flexible scheduling
* Hybrid or remote work opportunities
* Creative and collaborative work environment
* Professional development opportunities
* Opportunity to work with wellness, travel, and lifestyle brands
* Career growth potential

If you're passionate about digital storytelling, influencer partnerships, and creating engaging campaigns that inspire communities, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us shape the future of our growing wellness brand.

Pay: $35\.00 per hour

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
